LLM auditresponse for PKGBUILD:
<security_assessment>
<decision>SAFE</decision>
<details>
The PKGBUILD follows standard Arch packaging practices for a Node.js CLI tool. It fetches the official npm tarball from registry.npmjs.org and the corresponding npm-shrinkwrap.json from the upstream GitHub repository, both with verified checksums. The build uses `npm ci --ignore-scripts` to install pinned dependencies without running arbitrary lifecycle scripts, and the cache is confined to `${srcdir}/npm-cache`. The package() function installs the module under `/usr/lib/node_modules`, creates a symlink for the binary, adjusts the udev rule to use `TAG+=uaccess` (standard Arch practice), removes unneeded architectures and bundled libusb (to use the system library), and links license files. No suspicious network activity, obfuscation, or unexpected file operations are present.
</details>
<evidence>

<summary>Clean, standard AUR packaging for Node.js CLI tool</summary>
